acceptance.criterion: All required blocks and selected parts resolve at AGENT_VERIFIED or better without refusal.
All power and return pins are connected and decoupled, required inputs have defined states, and current, logic, loss and thermal checks pass under the declared conditions.
An actual placed and routed board satisfies every design-intent constraint.
Zero DRC violations against the selected fabrication profile.
Fabrication files, BOM and pick-and-place files are generated and independently inspected.
Fabricated board passes rail, disabled-state and required motor-function tests with the specified external fixture.

constraints.description: ENGINEERING_DEFAULT: operate on an indoor open bench at 15–35 degC ambient, with natural convection and no heatsink or fan.

ENGINEERING_DEFAULT: design for at most 100 degC estimated driver junction temperature at the stated continuous loads and 35 degC ambient. Record the selected source thermal model, copper assumptions and conduction/switching loss budget; an estimate is not a measured junction temperature.

ENGINEERING_DEFAULT: common-ground host outputs are LOW at 0–0.4 V and HIGH at 2.4 V to the 3.2–3.4 V logic rail, at up to 2 mA per control line. Host inputs accept LOW <=0.8 V and HIGH >=2.0 V and load each returned signal by at most 50 uA and 50 pF. Prove compatibility with selected devices; 5 V logic is not required.

ENGINEERING_DEFAULT permitted sequence: establish motor VM with passive drive disable asserted and all externally driven control pins held LOW; then establish VLOGIC while remaining disabled. Enable drive only after both rails are measured within their accepted intervals and the selected devices have completed source-qualified startup/reset/wake waits. Shutdown: assert disable while VM and VLOGIC remain present; wait until winding current has decayed to the qualified zero-current detection threshold and the motor is at rest; set all host-driven signal pins LOW, remove VLOGIC, then remove VM. Select and document waits from source limits or a qualified fixture measurement with explicit uncertainty and margin; no arbitrary fixed device timing is asserted. No control line may be HIGH while VLOGIC is absent; returned encoder/Hall signals are powered only by VLOGIC. The selected circuit must support this sequence without back-powering or energizing windings. Other sequences and hot plugging are outside scope.

ENGINEERING_DEFAULT: motor source plus an external shunt clamp maintain the declared input envelope for returned current up to 0.80 A and returned energy up to 0.10 J per event, with events at least 1 s apart. This is a finite test-fixture requirement, not an assumed sink capability of an ordinary bench supply. Supply and motor leads are each at most 0.3 m. Select local bypass/bulk storage for the driver; no motor hot plugging or external mechanical back-driving. Returned current and energy limits are distinct: neither is an unlimited-duration sink rating.

All motors, host controllers and test fixtures are external. Motor electrical bounds are acceptance conditions on the external fixture, not manufacturer facts about an unspecified motor. Preserve distinct motor outputs, logic signals and common-return connectivity.

ENGINEERING_DEFAULT external fixture: total rotating kinetic energy at the commanded operating speed is at most 0.020 J; stored energy in any spring or lifted load is zero. Stop by coasting before reversing; host waits for rest. The external motor is not mechanically driven by another actuator. Qualify inductive energy separately using winding current and inductance bounds.

requirements: Drive one star-connected three-phase BLDC motor using three independently controlled half-bridges; support 0.50 A winding-current magnitude at 10 kHz PWM.

Accept three 3.3 V push-pull Hall inputs and forward them independently to the host at up to 1000 transitions/s per channel. Host computes six-step commutation, inserts source-qualified dead time and keeps exactly one source and one sink phase active while the third phase floats.

ENGINEERING_DEFAULT external fixture: line-to-line winding resistance >=24 ohm and line-to-line inductance 1–10 mH, no external mechanical back-driving, 20 mA maximum combined Hall supply load. Host disables on Hall codes 000 or 111.

The three-phase external host commands must not be replaced with a brushed two-terminal motor output or a two-phase stepper interface. Closed-loop speed regulation, sensorless startup and field-oriented control are outside scope.

summary: Build a low-voltage three-phase brushless DC commutation module with three Hall-sensor inputs. This negative brief deliberately asks for a different motor topology, not a higher-current variant of a brushed or stepper bridge.
